arguments.query: Document Playwright MCP versus CLI usage for persistent exploratory browser interactions.

content.text:
Available Libraries:

- Title: Playwright MCP
- Context7-compatible library ID: /microsoft/playwright-mcp
- Description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides browser automation capabilities using Playwright, enabling LLMs to interact with web pages through structured accessibility snapshots without needing vision models.
- Code Snippets: 651
- Source Reputation: High
- Benchmark Score: 85.57
- Versions: v0.0.80
----------
- Title: Playwright CLI
- Context7-compatible library ID: /microsoft/playwright-cli
- Description: Playwright CLI provides a token-efficient command-line interface for Playwright, specifically designed for coding agents to automate browser interactions without loading large tool schemas into the model context.
- Code Snippets: 359
- Source Reputation: High
- Benchmark Score: 85.58
----------
- Title: Playwright
- Context7-compatible library ID: /microsoft/playwright
- Description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation, enabling cross-browser testing of Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with a single API.
- Code Snippets: 8041

- Benchmark Score: 81.28
- Versions: v1.51.0, v1.58.2, v1.61.0, v1.63.0
----------
- Title: Playwright
